info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Servicing Issue Resolution API
info.description: The Servicing Issue Resolution API facilitates the effective management and resolution of servicing-related issues within the banking system. Through this API, users can update and modify existing servicing issues, ensuring that resolutions are applied promptly and efficiently. Typical consumers include customer support teams and operational staff who handle issue resolutions. This API is essential for maintaining high service quality and enhancing customer satisfaction in banking services.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific servicing issue identified by its ID. Ensure all necessary fields are provided in the request body to successfully update the issue.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update specific attributes of the servicing issue identified by RES-100045. The JSON schema outlines the required and optional fields that can be modified in this request.
